meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将计划或讨论拆解为可追踪的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将需求或讨论转化为可执行的工单并追踪依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or discussions into trackable tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn requirements or discussions into actionable tickets with dependency tracking.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将计划、规格或当前对话拆解成一组可独立验证的“子弹票”，每张票标明它依赖哪些前置票，并发布到配置好的追踪器（本地文件或真实平台）。
howto.when: 当你提供计划、规格或讨论内容，并希望将其分解为可执行的任务时触发。

say.text: 把这个功能需求拆成任务票。
say.note: Claude 会分析需求并生成依赖关系清晰的票列表。

say.text: 把当前对话中的待办事项整理成票。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键点并生成可追踪的任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can break a plan, spec, or conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking dependencies, and publish them to the configured tracker (local files or a real issue tracker).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a plan, spec, or discussion content and want it decomposed into actionable tickets.

say_en.text: Break this feature request into tickets.
Turn the current conversation's action items into tickets.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key points and create trackable tickets.
